freeze_semantics: The aliases, search order, immutable selection rules, and negative-evidence policy were fixed before final candidate classification. Earlier intake observations were retained as leads and rechecked at this cutoff.
search_order: repository-local Lean proof bodies and wrappers
pinned mathlib and every locally materialized pinned package
the theorem author's public Lean project
other immutable public Lean repositories and code indexes
already-materialized post-pin mathlib history as discovery-only evidence
primary human source for statement discrimination
query_families: repository metadata and immutable commit/archive resolution

immutable_selection_rules.repo_local: Bind results to the repository base revision and tree; no proof credit transfers from another target.
immutable_selection_rules.mathlib: Only the clean lake-manifest revision is a pinned candidate. Locally present later Git objects are discovery-only and may not be checked out or imported.
immutable_selection_rules.external: Resolve a moving ref to a 40-hex commit and tree, bind source and archive hashes, and record native toolchain/dependency/license constraints before classification.
immutable_selection_rules.statement_match: Compare graph polarity, density normalization, part indexing, part-size quantification/growth, threshold form, epsilon domain, binders, and conclusion. A named neighboring theorem is not an exact candidate.
immutable_selection_rules.negative_search: Bind each bounded search to a response/output hash or explicit access failure; never infer global absence or saturation.

credential_policy: Anonymous public read-only HTTP and repository metadata only; no credentials, dependency clone/fetch, Lake update/build, checkout, or .lake mutation.
network_policy: Read-only discovery is allowed. All Lean validation uses the existing pinned local environment with network denied.
expected_negative_evidence: indexing, credential, API-rate, and saturation limitations
status_boundary: This protocol supports a bounded, reproducible immutable candidate audit only. It does not establish an exact proof route, accepted state, audit completion, or theorem completion.
